title: Deploy Forward ingest payload
description: The capture wire contract: the JSON body a tracker POSTs to {apiBase}/ingest with `Authorization: Bearer <deviceToken>`. Metadata only, by construction: no prompt text, no code, no file names, no working directories, no credentials, no user-typed rates ever appear in this shape. The server treats every field as untrusted input; trust labels are server-derived and never accepted from the wire. Sessions are chunked (100 per request by the reference tracker; the server rejects >500). Optional fields are DROPPED when absent, never null-filled - payload bytes are the upload digest, so field presence is contractual.

trackerVersion.description: The submitting client's version, for adapter-drift forensics. Coerced to string server-side; never trusted for anything else.

sessions.description: One entry per captured agent session. The server responds per-session with accepted / unchanged / flagged / rejected.

unknownModels.description: Consent-gated (off by default): occurrence tallies of model ids the bundled pricing table cannot price - never a rate, never a spend. Sent on the first chunk only.

tokenCounts.description: Raw token counts as the harness recorded them. Real counters only: an adapter never estimates, smears, or fabricates a count.

id.description: The RAW model id from the transcript, client-side sanitized only (trimmed, length-capped). Canonicalization is a server concern.
Normalized skill/agent NAME only - never arguments, message content, or the skill body.

daySlice.description: One UTC day's share of a multi-day session - real observed atoms clipped at midnights, never a smear. Present only when a session touches more than one UTC day. Slices must sum exactly to the session totals; the server drops the whole array if they don't.

mue.description: Model-Use Efficiency: the context-scaling summary for one session. STATUS ONLY - never ranked, and omitted (field absent) when the session is too short to estimate honestly.

outcome.description: A candidate shipped outcome observed in-session: type, hashes and identifiers only - never a diff, code, or prompt text. Self-attested on the wire; verification (and any weight) is derived server-side against GitHub.

attribution.description: Explicit user-level telemetry grants for a locally-resolved repo. The raw working directory is never uploaded; the server re-validates every grant against the authenticated uid.

tool.description: The harness that produced the session. The set the server accepts; the reference tracker currently emits nine of these (not cursor/vscode).

toolSessionId.description: The harness's own session id. The charset is a hard server gate (an id outside it is rejected, not flagged).

model.description: The session's dominant raw model id.

models.description: Per-model buckets; sums to `tokens` minus filtered pseudo-models.

entryPoint.description: Best-effort entry surface (cli, vscode, desktop, subagent, unknown, ...). Status only.

thinkingTokens.description: Observable reasoning-token count where the harness records one. Status only - never priced, never summed into output.

endedAt.description: Epoch milliseconds; must not precede startedAt (hard reject).

repoHash.description: An HMAC of the repo identity computed with a device-local key that never leaves the machine - distinct repos are countable without any name or URL crossing the wire. Null when no repo resolved.

orgRepo.description: Org-enrolled devices ONLY: the normalized lowercase owner/name slug. A non-enrolled device never puts a repo name on the wire - this is a client-side privacy gate, not a server courtesy.

longestLoopMs.description: Longest continuous span of agent work with no human input.

messageCount.description: Assistant messages seen. 0 is a tombstone: the session vanished locally and the server should treat prior data as withdrawn.
